topic: remove dried mud from suede shoes
core_question: How do I get mud off suede shoes? (secondary: How do I fix a torn window screen?)
answer_summary: Never scrub wet mud into suede — let it dry completely first, then brush it off with a suede brush; treat any leftover shadow with a suede eraser.; after the topic shift: Remove the old spline, lay new screen mesh over the frame, and press it into the groove with a spline roller and new spline cord, then trim the excess.
